messages:
ravi: Heads-up: release cut blocked by deploy-bot. Promotion validation failed: tag 'canary-20260323' has inconsistent registry manifests across mirrors.

meI: typo in header, can you paste the error?

ravi: deploy-bot log: "promotion rejected: manifest-blob-mismatch (expected sha256:40f1e... got sha256:72a9b...)". Happened during preflight blob verification.

ci-runner: saw this in publish step: 'push manifest OK (sha256:40f1e...)' then mirror-sync job returned 502 for blob fetch and later created a new manifest (72a9b...) when retry completed with partial blobs. Logs attached to CI job 6543.

deploy-bot: system: promotion is on hold; lock owner: deploy-bot. Manual intervention required to resume.

ravi: Is this safe to pin to primary manifest (40f1e)? We need to decide quickly — change window in 30m.

mei: If we pin, some nodes pulling from mirror might fail until mirror finishes replication. But mirror should converge in <10m. Alternative is to rollback to previous canary and rebuild. That will push the window back.

ops-bot: Reminder: canary is used by internal traffic only today, not prod. Risk low but need to ensure no data loss.

ravi: Proposed plan: manual digest pin to primary + run 3x smoke pulls against each mirror + mark release note. If any mirror fails repeatedly, revert.

tara: I can run the mirror checks and do the promote CLI. Commands I will run:
```
# inspect digests
skopeo inspect docker://registry.redwood.ai/redwood/inference:canary-20260323 | jq -r .Digest
skopeo inspect docker://mirror-eu.redwood.ai/redwood/inference:canary-20260323 | jq -r .Digest
# promote with digest
deploy-bot promote --tag canary-20260323 --expected-digest sha256:40f1e... --approve-by tara
```

ci-runner: note: job 6543 shows mirror retry created a new manifest referencing a smaller blob set, size mismatch. Might cause older nodes to 404 if they try to fetch missing blobs.

mei: ok run the checks, but include a blob fetch test: `curl -I https://mirror-eu.redwood.ai/v2/redwood/inference/blobs/sha256:<blob>` for top 2 blobs.

tara: doing checks now. Primary digest = sha256:40f1e5c9. Mirror A digest = sha256:40f1e5c9. Mirror B digest (mirror-eu) = sha256:72a9b334 earlier, but rechecked -> 40f1e5c9 now. Blob HEADs: blob1 200, blob2 200 across primary+mirrors.

ravi: Good. Any transient 502s?

tara: Mirror B had 502 at 09:12:03 (CI logs), but current HEAD ok. I will run promote with digest pin and then kick smoke.

tara: promoted with --expected-digest sha256:40f1e5c9 and forced unlock. deploy-bot: promotion resumed by @tara, new promotion event id=promo-20260323-72.

ops-bot: smoke run started (3 replicas eu-west).

ci-runner: smoke pulls: replica1 success, replica2 success, replica3 transient 504 then success. No 404s.

mei: looks green. Please add infra ticket to prevent manifests being re-created on partial blob failure (INFRA-2159). Also add gating so deploy-bot verifies blob HEADs across n mirrors before promoting.

ravi: I'll update release notes: "manual manifest pin to sha256:40f1e5c9 due to mirror replication race; mirrors healthy now; follow-up infra audit (INFRA-2159)". Marking release window as unblocked.

deploy-bot: promotion completed; release window cleared.

ravi: Thanks everyone. Closing thread. :party_parrot:
